jobs.prompt: Fix review findings in the Needs-you triage (tools/needs-you-triage.mjs, tools/autopilot-ready-deps.mjs, tools/journal.mjs only if needed), tests added to tests/needs-you-triage.test.mjs (fakes only). 1 MEDIUM the owner-cause regex for checkout blockers misses most integrationBlocker reasons (tools/autopilot.mjs near lines 573-600 and 813-822: revert in progress, unmerged paths, local changes on integrate output paths, uncommitted changes or could not be checked, not on a branch, not a swarm/* branch, could not be inspected, no declared output paths): treat EVERY integrate-checkout item as an owner item (the owner commits, moves or decides), with the Decision needed text built from the blocker reason; only 'integrate' items (the run could not be integrated for a non-checkout reason, e.g. a failed gate) stay fixable. 2 MEDIUM a swarm-fix close must not suppress the integrate blocker forever: the resolution written by closeItem for a swarm-fix close carries an expiry (24 hours) honoured by integrateBlockerSuppressed (tools/journal.mjs) so autopilot can raise it again later; and one swarm-fix goal per cause: when the same cause (same item subtype and project and run) re-appears after expiry and a goal already exists, do not file another goal and do not retry, leave the item open for the owner with the goal id in the text. 3 MEDIUM the integrate handler's outputPaths must come from the run state: build them with runIntegrateOutputPaths(run, events, { runs }) (tools/autopilot.mjs) and refuse (not-ok) when a run with integratable jobs has no resolvable outputs, like autopilot does; item.outputPaths is never used. 4 MEDIUM triage only the project the autopilot pass belongs to (primaryRoot): never triage other registered projects from another project's pass, so items are never handled twice; the state and lock stay keyed by the project root. 5 LOW the lock is stale when it is older than the stale age (30 minutes since its last refresh) even if its pid is alive (pid reuse), or when its pid is dead; after writing the lock re-read it and give up unless it names this process; remove the dead code near line 247. Tests for each. Keep every existing test passing (tests/needs-you-triage.test.mjs, tests/autopilot-*.test.mjs, tests/inbox*.test.mjs, tests/journal*.test.mjs).
